summary: Experienced Information Technology Manager committed to maintaining innovative technical skills and up-to-date industry knowledge. My excellent problem solving skills, diagnostic ability and communication skills are assets that allow me to excel and adapt to virtually any situation.

experience.title: Information Technology Manager
responsibilities: Maintain budget and implement new technologies.
Lead migration of Accounting and Billing system upgrade.
Manage firewall, network monitoring, and server monitoring.
Recommend architectural and integration solutions.
Train IT team on network security and troubleshooting.
Ensure network, system, and data availability and integrity.
Manage migrations: Exchange 2003 to 2010, Windows XP/Office 2003 to Windows 7/Office 2010, Office 2010 to 2013, physical servers to VMware ESXi.
Manage IT vendor and telecommunications contracts.
Provide documentation for help desk processes.
Implement company policies, procedures, and standards for data security.

experience.title: Technical Project Lead
responsibilities: Maintain client relationships and technical integrity of infrastructure.
Manage engineers on client projects, including time management and resource scheduling.
Migrate Novell 6.0 Cluster with Groupwise to 6.5.
Ensure timely project completion.
Manage IT department at client sites, including helpdesk.

experience.title: Systems Engineer
responsibilities: Install, support, and maintain Novell, Windows NT4, 2000, and 2003 servers.
Patch over 800 servers.
Implement new infrastructure from the server side.
Stabilize Novell Groupwise 6.5.
Implement and maintain SQL Cluster on Windows 2003.

experience.title: Network Analyst
responsibilities: Manage and support Novell 4.x/5.x, Windows NT4, 2000, Citrix MetaFrame XPa, and GroupWise 5.x.
Provide second‑level support for PC and network issues.

experience.title: Night Desk Supervisor
responsibilities: Supervise employees and handle issue escalations.
Manage projects and ensure on‑time completion.
Maintain client relationships.

experience.title: Senior Network Engineer
responsibilities: Manage LAN/WAN infrastructure.
Evaluate, purchase, implement, and maintain Novell and Windows NT servers.
Manage Cisco switches, routers, and WAN T1 connections.

experience.title: Network Analyst
responsibilities: Support 130+ Novell servers and NDS directory.
Upgrade and maintain servers and workstation clients.

experience.title: Network Support Specialist
responsibilities: Install and support software, hardware, network, phone system, and voicemail.
Plan company move, network wiring, and phone system upgrade.

experience.title: Service Manager
responsibilities: Install and maintain customer systems and network installations.
Roll out new systems and supervise technicians.
